Compared with [[Tallon Roll (PC Errata 2017 slip)]] (31 May 2017): Same words as the 2017 slip. This is a full card image again, with the white italic “E” in the black lower border.

The 2017 slip and the same area of the E card image, scaled to the slip's width; nothing else is edited.
